args: code=(async()=>{let l=app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf();let a=[...l.view.containerEl.querySelectorAll("a.internal-link")].find(a=>a.dataset.href?.includes("#2. 熵给出"));if(!a)return "missing anchor";a.scrollIntoView({block:"center"});app.workspace.trigger("hover-link",{event:new MouseEvent("mouseover",{bubbles:true,ctrlKey:true,metaKey:true}),source:"preview",hoverParent:l.view,targetEl:a,linktext:a.dataset.href,sourcePath:l.view.file.path});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));return JSON.stringify({href:a.dataset.href,popovers:[...document.querySelectorAll(".hover-popover")].map(x=>x.innerText.slice(0,6000))});})()
